scripts.dev: npm run build && node packages/vellym/dist/cli.mjs dev
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run --project integration
scripts.validate: npm run build && node packages/vellym/dist/cli.mjs validate --config how-to-use/vellym.config.yaml
scripts.pack:check: npm run build && npm pack --workspace vellym --dry-run --json
scripts.verify:scale: npm run build && node scripts/bench-fixture.mjs --out /tmp/vellym-ci-scale-3000 --pages 3000 && node scripts/bench-scale.mjs --config /tmp/vellym-ci-scale-3000/vellym.config.yaml --port 4277 --label ci-3000 --assert
scripts.verify:scale:tickets: npm run build && node scripts/bench-fixture.mjs --out /tmp/vellym-ci-scale-tickets --tickets 1000 && node scripts/bench-scale.mjs --config /tmp/vellym-ci-scale-tickets/vellym.config.yaml --port 4278 --label ci-tickets-1000 --tickets --assert
